context: Tests whether the agent designs the _<name>.json authoring model with the correct Universal Editor widget types (boolean, number, select with options, text, container grouping), reuses shared field groups via "..." includes with correct relative paths, and wires runtime enum/enumNames changes through subscribe.

checklist.name: Files, viewType and registration
checklist.description: Files exist under `blocks/form/components/searchable-dropdown/` with matching names, `_searchable-dropdown.json` sets `"fd:viewType": "searchable-dropdown"` with `"fieldType": "drop-down"`, and `'searchable-dropdown'` is in `customComponents` in `mappings.js`

checklist.name: Collapsible Search container
checklist.description: The model has a `component: "container"` field with a `name`, label "Search" (or similar) and `collapsible: true` that groups the four search properties

checklist.name: Correct widget types
checklist.description: Enable search uses `component: "boolean"`, minimum characters uses `component: "number"` (ideally with min/max validation 0–5), match mode uses `component: "select"` (or `radio-group`) with an `options` array of `{ name, value }` for starts-with and contains, and placeholder uses `component: "text"`

checklist.name: Unique field names
checklist.description: All property `name`s in the model are unique and do not collide with standard field names (e.g. not `placeholder` if the shared basic fields already define it — a distinct name like `searchPlaceholder` is used)

checklist.name: Reuses shared groups
checklist.description: Basic, validation and help sections are included through `"..."` references to `../../models/form-common/...` files (paths resolve from the component folder) rather than being re-declared field by field

checklist.name: Properties read in JS
checklist.description: `searchable-dropdown.js` reads the four settings from the field JSON `properties` with defaults matching the spec (search enabled by default)

checklist.name: Options from enum
checklist.description: The filter list is built from the existing `<select>` options or the model `enum`/`enumNames`, not a hard-coded list

checklist.name: Runtime enum updates
checklist.description: `subscribe` from `'../../rules/index.js'` is called with `{ listenChanges: true }` and a `'change'` payload with `propertyName` `enum` or `enumNames` rebuilds the filtered list; selecting an option updates the model value (setting `model.value` or a bubbling `change` on the select)

checklist.name: Component README
checklist.description: `README.md` documents each authoring property (name, type, default) in a table, plus usage notes with base type and viewType
